@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: 'Inbox: only the owner of the root delivers, and one scan claims each file'
+---
+## What
+The plan says "Only the process that owns the root delivers". The code only assumes it. `Router.swift:1204` makes `JSONLRecorder(directory:)`, which claims the root lazily, and `persistsIndex` depends only on the recording level. A process that does not own the root can still register durable sessions and start watchers. Two directories or two processes that hold one session scan one inbox, and each checks only its own cached ledger. `SessionMessageLoopGuardTests.swift:40` shows the race.
+
+- Start a watcher (and scan) only when this process holds `RecordingRootOwnership` for the root of the session (see `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Recording/RecordingRootLock.swift` and `Sinks.swift`, `ensureRootOwnership()`).
+- Make each delivery claim its file with an atomic rename (for example to `inbox/.<ulid>.md.claimed`) before `hand`. Only the process that wins the rename delivers. The first scan of the owner recovers claimed files, and the ledger check keeps this idempotent.
+- `restoreThenDeliver` must not remove a file that another scan delivered: a failed restore removes the file only if it is still there, and the receipt does not say `refused` for a message that was delivered.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A directory that does not own the root starts no watcher.
+- [ ] Two directories that watch one inbox deliver each file once.
+- [ ] A claimed file left by a crash is delivered once at the next start.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Extend `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/RouterSessionDirectoryInboxTests.swift`: two directories on one inbox; a non-owner directory; a `.claimed` file at start. Wait on events, not on the clock.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter RouterSessionDirectoryInboxTests`, then the full `swift test` once. Expected: all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+`mailbox-plan.md` says "Only the process that owns the root delivers".
